component.alias: T10Link, Honeywell T10, Honeywell T10 Pro, Honeywell T10+, Honeywell T9, T-Series, Resideo, HomeKit Thermostat, Thermostat, HVAC
component.notes:
T10Link: Honeywell Home T9 / T10 / T10 Pro thermostats controlled LOCALLY (Apple HomeKit protocol on the LAN), through the T10Link bridge service. No Honeywell/Resideo cloud and no Resideo account are needed. Full manual: the Documentation tab.
A BRIDGE IS REQUIRED This profile talks to the T10Link bridge, a small service that is paired with the thermostat over HomeKit. It runs on the Savant host Mac itself, another Mac, a Raspberry Pi or any Linux box on the same network. If the bridge is NOT on the Savant host, add the Savant host's IP to allowed_clients in the bridge's config.json, or the bridge refuses Savant's connection.
SETUP 1. Install the bridge, list the thermostats in its config.json and pair each one once: t10link pair (Menu > Connect HomeKit on the thermostat shows the code; it changes each time that screen opens). A thermostat must not already be in Apple Home. Or pair on the bridge's web page: http://(bridge IP):2401 2. Ethernet: set Device IP Address to the machine running the bridge. Port 2400. 3. HVAC data table: one row per thermostat, all on this one component. Entity = Zone, ThermostatAddress [1] = the thermostat's position in config.json (1, 2, 3 ...). Tick Heat, Cool and Auto as the system supports. Leave Fan unticked: HomeKit doesn't expose fan mode. 4. Upload the configuration.
SEVERAL THERMOSTATS One bridge and ONE component serve up to 8 thermostats (up to 16 with a regenerated profile). Don't add a second T10Link component for the same bridge.
WHAT WORKS (T10 firmware 1.5.3) Mode Off/Heat/Cool/Auto, heat and cool setpoints, current temperature, humidity, heating/cooling state, RedLINK room sensors (temperature, humidity, motion), occupancy, filter reminders. Fan mode and hold are not available over HomeKit.
SAVANT SCHEDULER Turn the thermostat's own schedule OFF (at the thermostat) and let Savant's climate scheduler run it. The T10 only takes the setpoint of the mode it's in (Heat: heat setpoint, Cool: cool setpoint, Auto: both). A setpoint for the other mode is saved by the bridge (T_SAVED_SETPOINTS), shown in Savant, and written as soon as the thermostat switches to that mode.
STATES Savant HVAC: ThermostatCurrentTemperature_1, ThermostatCurrentHeatPoint_1, ThermostatCurrentCoolPoint_1, ThermostatCurrentHumidity_1, ThermostatMode_1, IsCurrentHVACMode*_1, IsCurrentHVACState*_1. T_MODE, T_STATE, T_TEMP, T_HEAT_SETPOINT, T_COOL_SETPOINT, T_PENDING, T_ERROR, T_FILTER1_CHANGE ... SENSORn_NAME / _TEMP / _HUMIDITY / _MOTION for up to 4 room sensors. Thermostat 2 onwards: the same with _2 (ThermostatMode_2) or T2_ (T2_MODE, T2_SENSOR1_TEMP). SYS_ONLINE (gate automations on 1), SYS_ERROR, SYS_PAIRED. Full list in STATES.md / the Documentation tab.
Thermostat state is only ever set from what the thermostat reports, never assumed from a button press.
====================== Change Log ================== Version: 1.3.0 Change: Bridge web page (port 2401) for status, pairing and adding thermostats. Several thermostats on one bridge and one component: one HVAC data table row per thermostat (ThermostatAddress 1, 2, 3 ...). HVAC actions now send the ThermostatAddress; the custom actions take an optional Thermostat argument (blank = 1). New states T_IP, T_PAIRED, T_SENSOR_COUNT, SYS_THERMOSTAT_COUNT. Needs bridge 1.3.0; existing single-thermostat setups keep every state name. Version: 1.2.0 Change: The bridge now installs on macOS (including the Savant host) as well as Linux / Raspberry Pi (32- and 64-bit). Profile unchanged apart from these notes. Version: 1.1.2 Change: Auto can now be ticked in the HVAC data table. Blueprint enables the Auto column only when the profile has the ThermostatCurrentSetPoint state, so the bridge now sends ThermostatCurrentSetPoint_1 (the active setpoint in Heat / Cool). Needs bridge 1.1.2. Version: 1.1.1 Change: HVAC section matches Savant's own Honeywell T-Series profile for Auto (dual setpoint): added IncreaseTemperatureAuto / DecreaseTemperatureAuto and the CurrentAutoChangeOverStatus state variable (CurrentChangeOverStatus_1, true in Auto). Version: 1.1.0 Change: Works with Savant's climate scheduler: a setpoint for the mode the thermostat isn't in is saved and applied when it switches mode, instead of being refused. New T_SAVED_SETPOINTS state and ClearSavedSetpoints action. Version: 1.0.0 Change: First release. Savant connection on port 2400.
